content: The imported project memory records that link_cable_data_received was written by core0 and read by a core1 watchdog loop; without volatile, optimized Release builds could miss the update while Debug appeared to work. When reviewing shared flags, check the current synchronization contract and do not treat Debug-only success as evidence that cross-core visibility is correct.
title: RP2040 cross-core flags require explicit visibility handling

title: Check CMake build type before diagnosing UART symptoms

Revisit only when requested; do not present this proposal as implemented behavior.
